_comment: Constitutional facts the page cannot derive. Each carries the sentence it came from, so a CI check can fail when an amendment changes the wording. Members and thresholds are NOT here — they are counted live from members.md.

tier-b.name: Tier B
tier-b.quote: Deliberation runs for a stated period of less than seven days.

tier-c.name: Tier C
tier-c.quote: Deliberation runs for at least seven days.

layer-4.name: Amendment
layer-4.quote: Two endorsing reviews start the 7-day deliberation clock.

fixed.label: Constitution expires
fixed.quote: This Constitution expires at 23:59 (UK time) on Monday, 30 November 2026
fixed.note: Unless re-ratified or replaced by two-thirds of all members. If it lapses, functions revert to the College.

fixed.label: Re-ratification must have entered deliberation
fixed.note: A re-ratification or replacement proposal must have obtained its endorsements and entered seven-day deliberation.

fixed.label: Interim role holders' terms end
fixed.quote: extended to 23:59 (UK time) on Monday, 2 November 2026
fixed.note: Extended by pull request #2, adopted under §6 on 4 October. Ends earlier if holders are elected under §3.2. §6's expedited amendment window was not extended and closed at 23:59 on 4 October.
